import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] b = new long[20];

    static long calc(long val, long lvl) {
        long q = val / b[(int) lvl];
        val %= b[(int) lvl];
        if (val == 0)
            return q * lvl;
        else
            return q * lvl + Math.min(calc(val, lvl - 1), lvl + calc(b[(int) lvl] - val, lvl - 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        b[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 17; ++i)
            b[i] = b[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long temp = n;
        int digits = 0;
        while (temp != 0) {
            temp /= 10;
            ++digits;
        }
        System.out.println(calc(n, digits + 2));
        sc.close();
    }
}
